q.en: An ARINC 429 word uses ODD parity. The first 31 bits contain 14 ones. The parity bit (bit 32) and the total number of ones of the whole word are:

explain.vi: Tổng số bit 1 phải lẻ: 14 là chẵn nên bit chẵn lẻ = 1.
explain.en: The total number of ones must be odd: 14 is even so the parity bit = 1.
